## Packs that map to no surface

* `footstep/wood` — 16 file(s). §63.4 records the Wood pack as exterior-flavoured, so it is not interior `hardwood`, and §62.4 has no exterior timber surface. Assigning it to `hardwood` anyway would put a deck creak under a living-room floor.
